test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following incidents took place after the victory of the British in the Battle of Plassey, in 1757?

options.text: No new buildings and institutions were developed.
Trade of the British East India Company expanded.
The port cities of Madras, Calcutta and Bombay were destroyed.
People stayed away from the colonial cities of Madras, Calcutta and Bombay.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Trade of the British East India Company expanded.**__

Battle of Plassey - 

__
 
• It took place on June 23, 1757.
 
• It was fought between the forces of East India Company headed by Robert Clive and Siraj-Ud-Daulah (Nawab of Bengal). 
 
• It resulted in the decisive victory of the East India Company over a much larger force of Siraj-Ud-Daulah. 
 
• After the Battle of Plassey, the Britishers virtually monopolized the trade and commerce of Bengal. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Shuja-Ud-Daula -
 
 
• He was Nawab of Avadh (Oudh) and took the title Nawab Wazir. 
 
• He was son of Nawab Safdarjang.
 
• He is associated with the Battle of Buxar.
